generate_random_data: generate random or synthetic input data batches for DLRM model training with configurable dense and sparse features
read_dataset: read and preprocess Criteo Kaggle or Terabyte dataset for DLRM training with optional data splitting and randomization
generate_uniform_input_batch: generate a batch of uniformly distributed dense and sparse feature inputs for DLRM model training
trace_profile: profile a memory access trace to compute stack distances and unique line accesses for synthetic data generation
trace_generate_lru: generate a synthetic memory access trace using LRU-based stack distance distribution from a profiled trace file
